name: MAYBANK
recent: Maybank 近期公告以主要股东（EPF、PNB、AmanahRaya、KWAP、YPB）的持股变动申报为主，同时有一项董事会成员变动。新闻方面，公司完成了 RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah 发行，并通过双批次美元债券筹集 US$700m。
notable: 完成 RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah 发行。
通过双批次美元债券筹集 US$700m。
董事会成员 Datuk Izham Bin Ismail 出现变动。
risks: 多家主要股东（EPF、PNB、AmanahRaya、KWAP、YPB）在多个交易日出现持股变动申报。

recent_en: Maybank's recent announcements are mainly changes in substantial shareholders' interests (EPF, PNB, AmanahRaya, KWAP, YPB), along with a boardroom change. In the news, the company completed a RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance and raised US$700m via a dual-tranche dollar bond sale.
notable_en: Completed a RM2.5bil AT1 sukuk mudharabah issuance.
Raised US$700m through a dual-tranche dollar bond sale.
Boardroom change involving Datuk Izham Bin Ismail.
risks_en: Several substantial shareholders (EPF, PNB, AmanahRaya, KWAP, YPB) filed changes in their shareholdings across multiple trading days.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 7,147,201,000, up 2.2% QoQ and down 0.9% YoY; net income was MYR 2,690,362,000, up 8.5% QoQ and 2.4% YoY; net margin was 37.6%, higher than 35.5% in the previous quarter.
